name: thinkrail
description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
one_liner: An experimental code editor from JetBrains that remembers how your project works and gets smarter about it the more you use it.
buyer: A software engineering team lead evaluating next-generation AI coding tools, not an external business buyer.
business_use_cases: An engineering team adopts it to cut the time developers spend re-explaining project context to AI assistants on every task.
A dev-tools reviewer or YouTuber covers it as part of a comparison series on agentic IDEs.
A consulting shop doing client codebase work uses its 'living specs' feature to onboard onto unfamiliar projects faster.

money_ideas.idea: There isn't an independent business here — it's JetBrains' own incubator product, not something to build a company on top of.

steal_this: Nothing to build this weekend — try it on a real project for personal productivity, but don't start a business around someone else's incubator tool.
